rules.summary: High/low are the base facts.
Trend is recognized from higher/lower highs and lows.
Small/large turns are distinct structural units.
Large/mid/small Dow structures are separated.
A line is selected according to purpose.
HL at reversal high/low; rising TL through two higher lows; falling TL through two lower highs; CH is parallel to TL and aligned to the corresponding recent opposite-side extreme.
Large-Dow line selection uses a line basically unbroken at selection and is not required to start at the absolute extreme.
Small-Dow lines are handled within one phase and may use near-symmetry/price clusters.
TL Zone uses wick-to-body around the start candle; body extension is allowed only with evidence/reason; no fixed numeric width.
Field and Action are separate concepts.
Three phases are recognized; no fixed timeframe mapping.
Upper-timeframe line/zone edge matters; proximity threshold is not fixed.
Full-phase confirmation after reaching a large-Dow edge; detector details remain TBD.
Small-Dow break detector remains TBD.
Small awareness revival.
Large awareness revival.
Intermediate TL and mid-Dow counter TL are separate.
Break -> new outer high/low -> higher structural priority -> TL/CH update -> Field remap; exact update timing remains TBD.
Return after TL break is an observation/search cue, not an entry trigger.

TL side reflects stronger/new participation and CH side freer/weaker behavior; TL break is structural-change candidate and CH break continuation/acceleration candidate; no numeric score and no entry trigger.

selection_semantics: High/low detection is separate from Anchor selection.
Retain multiple Anchor and TL candidates before Selection.
When otherwise comparable, gentler/slower slope is preferred.
Evaluate historical reactions on both TL Zone and CH Zone as a channel structure.
CH Zone uses the same width as TL Zone as a user-confirmed implementation semantic.
Use qualitative reaction labels only: CLEAR, WEAK, UNKNOWN.
Upper-timeframe/body-level reactions are more reliable than lower-timeframe wick-only reactions.
Reaction Cluster groups nearby candles into one reaction event.
Do not invent fixed pip, ATR, score, or timeframe thresholds.
